statement: Historical research-lead encoder bitmask ordering for 0x42 bits 0–31: 0–3 A,B,X,Y; 4 QAM; 5 R3; 6 View; 7 R4; 8 R5; 9 right bumper;10–13 D-pad down,right,left,up;14 Menu;15 L3;16 Steam;17 L4;18 L5;19 left bumper;20 right stick touch;21 right pad touch;22 right pad click;23 right trigger click;24 left stick touch;25 left pad touch;26 left pad click;27 left trigger click;28 right grip touch;29 left grip touch;30–31 unassigned. Kernel/SDL pinned source maps agree except bits 6 and 14 are Menu/View respectively, reversed versus historical encoder. This is an inferred software cross-check, not physical field validation.
